column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 21 (M23021): Ateraxis & Graurizard melacak Komandan lewat Pike.
# Tetap Inggris: Ateraxis, Chiloveig, Graurizard, Jojo, Lunasia, Caldwell Scarlet,
# Lentine, Boojum, Nirvana, Relics, Pike, Mokosh, Mangi Security, The Elmo,
# Collapse Storm, Red Zone, Doll, Neural cloud, P.M.C.

(Lentine's target from the start was the Commander on the Elmo. After confirming they had lost track of the Commander, rashly continuing to entangle with the enemy in the Collapse storm obviously lost its meaning.)
column2: (Sasaran Lentine sejak awal adalah Komandan di Elmo. Setelah memastikan jejak Komandan hilang, terus bergulat gegabah dengan musuh di dalam Collapse Storm jelas kehilangan maknanya.)

column1: (Recalling that the enemy once dispatched Dolls to infiltrate and assault their platform, the anger in Lentine's heart surged like a tidal wave.)
column2: (Mengingat musuh pernah mengirim Doll untuk menyusup dan menyerbu platform mereka, amarah di hati Lentine membuncah bagai gelombang pasang.)

column1: Evade enemy attacks, group up! Retreat!
column2: Hindari serangan musuh, berkumpul! Mundur!

column1: (The Mangi Security forces regrouped and evacuated toward the perimeter of the Collapse storm.)
column2: (Pasukan Mangi Security menata ulang barisan dan menyingkir ke arah pinggiran Collapse Storm.)

column1: Tch, the enemy is tougher than I thought, lost track of them.
column2: Cih, musuhnya lebih tangguh dari dugaanku, jejaknya hilang.

column1: Since they have the resolve to break into the collapse storm, the opponent definitely has a backup plan.
column2: Karena mereka bertekad menerobos ke dalam collapse storm, lawan pasti punya rencana cadangan.

column1: We need Mangi Security's movement trajectory in the collapse storm and the enemy's intelligence to deduce the direction the enemy might retreat.
column2: Kita butuh lintasan pergerakan Mangi Security di dalam collapse storm dan informasi musuh untuk menyimpulkan ke arah mana musuh mungkin mundur.

column1: Alright, if you find any traces, please be sure to sync the information with me.
column2: Baik, kalau kau menemukan jejak, tolong pastikan informasinya diteruskan padaku.

column1: (The heavily struck giant dragon curled up beside Ateraxis. The numerous scars on its body caused by the battle had long since healed with the regeneration of Boojum cells after a night had passed.)
column2: (Naga raksasa yang dihantam habis-habisan itu meringkuk di samping Ateraxis. Luka-luka di tubuhnya akibat pertempuran sudah lama menutup berkat regenerasi sel Boojum setelah semalam berlalu.)

column1: (Only one scar left on its head still showed a terrifying color to this day.)
column2: (Hanya satu bekas luka di kepalanya yang sampai hari ini masih menampakkan warna yang mengerikan.)

column1: (Ateraxis reached out and gently stroked that scar. The giant dragon roared as if in pain, then lowered its body and rubbed its neck towards Ateraxis's direction, seemingly craving comfort.)
column2: (Ateraxis mengulurkan tangan dan mengusap lembut bekas luka itu. Naga raksasa itu mengaum seolah kesakitan, lalu merendahkan tubuhnya dan menggesekkan lehernya ke arah Ateraxis, seakan mendambakan penghiburan.)

column1: This is... the power of Nirvana that Mother mentioned.
column2: Ini... kekuatan Nirvana yang disebut Ibu.

column1: Bear with it, Jojo, these injuries are not enough to endanger you. You'll be fine after properly replenishing Boojum cells later.
column2: Tahan sebentar, Jojo, luka-luka ini belum cukup membahayakanmu. Nanti kau akan baik-baik saja setelah sel Boojum-mu diisi ulang dengan benar.

column1: Can you no longer smell the Commander's scent?
column2: Kau sudah tidak bisa mencium aroma Komandan lagi?

column1: The flames of war will affect your sense of smell, but... the military has already stationed in Mokosh, the Commander probably won't stay in place.
column2: Kobaran perang memang mengganggu penciumanmu, tapi... militer sudah bercokol di Mokosh, Komandan kemungkinan tidak akan berdiam di tempat.

column1: As long as we hack into their lines, we can get clues, just wait patiently.
column2: Asal kita meretas jalur mereka, kita bisa dapat petunjuk, tunggu saja dengan sabar.

column1: Next time, we must catch the Commander, Graurizard.
column2: Lain kali, kita harus menangkap Komandan, Graurizard.

column1: Roar—
column2: Raung—

column1: Hehehe, wait? Hacking into the military or Mangi Security's backdoor to steal information is too slow, too slow~
column2: Hehehe, menunggu? Meretas pintu belakang militer atau Mangi Security untuk mencuri informasi itu terlalu lambat, terlalu lambat~

column1: You have a way.
column2: Kamu punya cara.

column1: Tell me.
column2: Katakan.

column1: Alright, little Ateraxis.
column2: Baiklah, Ateraxis kecil.

column1: When I was working for the Financial Conglomerate before, I left a little technical backdoor. There's an important thing, its coordinates will be periodically transmitted to me. Guess where that important thing is now?
column2: Waktu dulu aku bekerja untuk Financial Conglomerate, aku meninggalkan sedikit pintu belakang teknis. Ada satu benda penting yang koordinatnya dikirim ke aku secara berkala. Tebak, di mana benda penting itu sekarang?

column1: On the Commander's vehicle?
column2: Di kendaraan Komandan?

column1: Correct.
column2: Tepat.

column1: The Commander seems to always appear at these crucial time nodes and unexpectedly survive from various desperate situations. Is this a symbol of the Goddess's favor?
column2: Komandan sepertinya selalu muncul di titik-titik waktu genting seperti ini dan tak terduga selamat dari berbagai situasi tanpa harapan. Apa ini tanda perkenan Sang Dewi?

column1: Although I think someone will fiercely object, let's just say it is.
column2: Meski kurasa ada yang akan protes keras, anggap saja begitu.

column1: As long as we have the coordinates of the Pike, no matter how far apart, the Commander's tracks... can be immediately grasped.
column2: Asal kita punya koordinat Pike, sejauh apa pun jaraknya, jejak Komandan... bisa langsung kita kuasai.

column1: However, in this world, there is only one person who might be able to do this, and that's you.
column2: Tapi di dunia ini, cuma ada satu orang yang mungkin bisa melakukannya, dan itu kamu.

column1: (Before Chiloveig could finish speaking, Ateraxis closed her eyes and perceived the power of the "Relics" Chiloveig mentioned.)
column2: (Sebelum Chiloveig selesai bicara, Ateraxis memejamkan mata dan merasakan kekuatan "Relics" yang disebut Chiloveig.)

column1: (Stripping away all other sensations, keeping only the perception of the special power. The surrounding things seemed to gradually disappear. Beyond the distant area, scattered remnants of power guided Ateraxis's path forward.)
column2: (Mengupas semua indra lain, menyisakan hanya penginderaan terhadap kekuatan khusus itu. Benda-benda di sekitarnya seakan perlahan lenyap. Jauh di seberang kawasan itu, sisa-sisa kekuatan yang berserak menuntun jalan Ateraxis ke depan.)

column1: I found it, that special power... it's very recognizable.
column2: Aku menemukannya, kekuatan khusus itu... sangat mudah dikenali.

column1: As expected, little Ateraxis, you can feel "that" without any conditions...
column2: Memang beda Ateraxis kecil, kamu bisa merasakan "itu" tanpa syarat apa pun...

column1: Let's go, Graurizard, we're going to find the Commander.
column2: Ayo, Graurizard, kita akan mencari Komandan.

column1: I... really want to see that person right now.
column2: Aku... benar-benar ingin melihat orang itu sekarang juga.

column1: (Ateraxis gently touched the dragon's skin, then flipped onto the dragon's back, driving the somewhat staggering dragon to slowly rise into the air.)
column2: (Ateraxis menyentuh lembut kulit naga itu, lalu melompat ke punggungnya, memacu naga yang agak terhuyung itu perlahan naik ke udara.)

column1: Little Ateraxis, since I have pointed out the direction for you, can you answer a tiny tiny tiny little secret for me?
column2: Ateraxis kecil, karena aku sudah menunjukkan arahnya untukmu, boleh dong kamu jawab satu rahasia kecil kecil kecil untukku?

column1: Just treat it as a bestie chat between girls, okay?
column2: Anggap saja obrolan bestie sesama cewek, ya?

column1: Ask.
column2: Tanya.

column1: What is your wish, what is it that you seek from the 'Goddess'?
column2: Apa keinginanmu, apa yang kamu cari dari 'Sang Dewi'?

column1: That's not something you should know.
column2: Itu bukan hal yang perlu kamu tahu.

column1: Although I don't think you can discover my weakness, you will tirelessly try, and wait for an opportunity to manipulate or betray me at the final critical moment, right?
column2: Meski kurasa kamu tidak akan menemukan kelemahanku, kamu akan terus mencoba tanpa lelah, dan menunggu kesempatan untuk memanipulasi atau mengkhianatiku di detik paling genting, kan?

column1: Little Ateraxis—! How could you think that? We are biological sisters from different fathers and mothers!?
column2: Ateraxis kecil—! Kok kamu berpikir begitu? Kita ini saudari kandung dari ayah dan ibu yang berbeda!?

column1: I am not your sister, and besides, my wish has no exploitation value to you.
column2: Aku bukan saudarimu, lagi pula keinginanku tidak punya nilai untuk kamu manfaatkan.

column1: It only benefits myself, and only serves 'me'.
column2: Itu hanya menguntungkan diriku sendiri, dan hanya melayani 'aku'.

column1: (Leaving this sentence to Chiloveig, Ateraxis ignored her dissatisfaction and drove the giant dragon to sweep across the sky and leave.)
column2: (Setelah melontarkan kalimat itu pada Chiloveig, Ateraxis mengabaikan ketidakpuasannya dan memacu naga raksasa itu membelah langit dan pergi.)

column1: (It's just that Chiloveig's question seems to have stirred up her inner thoughts. Gently patting the giant dragon beneath her, Ateraxis mutters to herself in a nostalgic tone.)
column2: (Hanya saja pertanyaan Chiloveig sepertinya mengaduk isi hatinya. Sambil menepuk pelan naga raksasa di bawahnya, Ateraxis bergumam sendiri dengan nada nostalgik.)

column1: Jojo, remember when we were still 'children'—oh, you probably don't have much impression of it anymore, do you?
column2: Jojo, ingat waktu kita masih 'anak-anak'—ah, kamu mungkin sudah tidak punya banyak ingatan soal itu, ya?

column1: It's all because I took away most of the energy that you matured so late.
column2: Semua itu karena aku mengambil sebagian besar energinya, makanya kamu matang begitu terlambat.

column1: (A wave of warmth came from the giant dragon's consciousness, and to Ateraxis, this was exactly the language Graurizard used to express empathy.)
column2: (Segelombang kehangatan datang dari kesadaran naga raksasa itu, dan bagi Ateraxis, itulah persis bahasa yang dipakai Graurizard untuk menyatakan empati.)

column1: (At the very beginning, they were just one of the two embryos in the red crystal obelisk hidden in the underground cave of the Red Zone castle, observing the outside world solely through light, temperature, and vibration perception—and Ateraxis, possessing human genes, gained self-consciousness early on.)
column2: (Pada mulanya, mereka hanyalah dua embrio di dalam obelisk kristal merah yang tersembunyi di gua bawah tanah kastil Red Zone, mengamati dunia luar semata lewat penginderaan cahaya, suhu, dan getaran—dan Ateraxis, yang memiliki gen manusia, lebih dulu memperoleh kesadaran diri.)

column1: (Even when "Mother" hadn't noticed—she, who hadn't yet received the name "Ateraxis", was already learning and thinking.)
column2: (Bahkan saat "Ibu" belum menyadarinya—dia, yang belum menerima nama "Ateraxis", sudah belajar dan berpikir.)

column1: —Mother said that I seemed to have gained a human form because of my "desire to learn and communicate", while you were shaped into the appearance of an imaginary creature because of your "pursuit of individual performance"...
column2: —Ibu bilang aku mendapat wujud manusia karena "hasratku untuk belajar dan berkomunikasi", sementara kamu dibentuk menyerupai makhluk khayalan karena "pengejaranmu akan performa individu"...

column1: This is a very natural choice, however, our destinies were changed because of such thoughts.
column2: Ini pilihan yang sangat wajar, tapi takdir kita berubah gara-gara pikiran semacam itu.

column1: (Caldwell Scarlet, the woman who gave her life and knowledge, and allowed her to act as she pleased—Ateraxis harbors pure gratitude toward her. Hoping to fulfill her wish is not an empty claim.)
column2: (Caldwell Scarlet, perempuan yang memberinya kehidupan dan pengetahuan, serta membiarkannya bertindak sesuka hati—Ateraxis menyimpan rasa syukur yang murni padanya. Keinginannya mewujudkan harapan perempuan itu bukan omong kosong.)

column1: (However, Ateraxis has never been able to let go of the fact that she shaped her into the form of a human.)
column2: (Namun Ateraxis tak pernah bisa melepaskan kenyataan bahwa dia dibentuk menjadi berwujud manusia.)

column1: At the time of birth, biological offspring may experience an "imprinting" phenomenon towards specific objects and behaviors—such as a chick treating the first object it sees as its mother, or fish that can always migrate back to their birthplace.
column2: Saat lahir, keturunan makhluk hidup bisa mengalami fenomena "imprinting" terhadap objek dan perilaku tertentu—seperti anak ayam yang menganggap objek pertama yang dilihatnya sebagai induknya, atau ikan yang selalu bisa bermigrasi kembali ke tempat kelahirannya.

column1: Just like Dolls are programmed with a base Neural cloud, I am also trapped in a human body and way of thinking—
column2: Sama seperti Doll yang diprogram dengan Neural cloud dasar, aku pun terperangkap dalam tubuh dan cara berpikir manusia—

column1: In this way, no matter how much knowledge I master, I can only understand it from a human standpoint, and can only become like Mother, right?
column2: Dengan begitu, sebanyak apa pun pengetahuan yang kukuasai, aku cuma bisa memahaminya dari sudut pandang manusia, dan cuma bisa menjadi seperti Ibu, kan?

column1: (Gazing at the crossfire and slaughter on the battlefield below from the dragon's back, Ateraxis pressed her hand to her chest—although it was a simulated organ, there was indeed something called a heart beating there.)
column2: (Sambil menatap baku tembak dan pembantaian di medan tempur di bawah dari punggung naga, Ateraxis menekankan tangannya ke dada—meski itu organ simulasi, di sana memang ada sesuatu bernama jantung yang berdetak.)

column1: So, I will not act according to Mother's thoughts.
column2: Karena itu, aku tidak akan bertindak menurut pikiran Ibu.

column1: I want to see Lunasia entirely for my own wish—
column2: Aku ingin menemui Lunasia sepenuhnya demi keinginanku sendiri—

column1: Will you follow me, or Mother?
column2: Kamu akan mengikutiku, atau Ibu?

column1: (The giant dragon did not respond, but Ateraxis smiled. She affectionately stroked Graurizard's wound, which was pierced by energy not belonging to this world.)
column2: (Naga raksasa itu tidak menjawab, tapi Ateraxis tersenyum. Dengan penuh sayang dia mengusap luka Graurizard yang ditembus energi yang bukan milik dunia ini.)

column1: (This is the clearest signal possible.)
column2: (Ini isyarat yang paling jelas.)

column1: I know you are watching me too, Lunasia.
column2: Aku tahu kamu juga sedang mengamatiku, Lunasia.

column1: And you, are unwilling to share...
column2: Dan kamu, tidak rela berbagi...

column1: So, I challenge you, goddess—for the sake of…
column2: Maka, aku menantangmu, Dewi—demi…

column1: (At the same time, the military and Mangi Security also immediately located Graurizard's direction of movement.)
column2: (Di saat bersamaan, militer dan Mangi Security juga langsung menentukan arah pergerakan Graurizard.)

column1: That dragon charged toward the location where the Collapse storm previously occurred.
column2: Naga itu menerjang ke lokasi tempat Collapse Storm tadi terjadi.

column1: You mean to say the dragon's objective is the same as ours.
column2: Maksudmu tujuan naga itu sama dengan tujuan kita.

column1: Besides that person, I can't think of anyone else who could interest the dragon.
column2: Selain orang itu, aku tidak bisa memikirkan siapa lagi yang bisa menarik minat naga itu.

column1: Besides, I've encountered that dragon before, and I can tentatively guess that the other party might be related to our target.
column2: Lagi pula aku pernah berpapasan dengan naga itu, dan untuk sementara aku bisa menduga makhluk itu mungkin berkaitan dengan sasaran kita.

column1: Alright, we will arrange a squad to track the dragon's whereabouts.
column2: Baik, kami akan menyiapkan satu regu untuk melacak keberadaan naga itu.

column1: But I can only send one squad to assist your tracking mission.
column2: Tapi saya hanya bisa mengirim satu regu untuk membantu misi pelacakan Anda.

column1: Mokosh already has victory in its grasp, it shouldn't need a large army to suppress it, right.
column2: Kemenangan atas Mokosh sudah di genggaman, seharusnya tidak butuh pasukan besar untuk menekannya, kan.

column1: Dispatching a small number of troops over is easy to fall into a disadvantage. We still don't know if the other party has any fallback methods they haven't used yet.
column2: Mengirim pasukan dalam jumlah kecil gampang membuat kita terpojok. Kita masih belum tahu apakah pihak lawan punya cara cadangan yang belum mereka pakai.

column1: The instructions I received are completely opposite to yours.
column2: Instruksi yang saya terima justru berlawanan dengan Anda.

column1: At this stage, confirming the steady handover of the Mokosh regime is the most important thing.
column2: Pada tahap ini, memastikan peralihan kekuasaan Mokosh berjalan mulus adalah hal yang paling penting.

column1: You can dispatch a squad to track them, but it's best for you to stay in Mokosh yourself.
column2: Anda boleh mengirim satu regu untuk melacak mereka, tapi sebaiknya Anda sendiri tetap di Mokosh.

column1: Underestimating that person will only lead you into the trap they laid.
column2: Meremehkan orang itu hanya akan menyeretmu masuk ke jebakan yang dia pasang.

column1: I'll go personally. For Mokosh's affairs, I will send my logistics officer to contact you—no matter what it is, you can tell me directly.
column2: Saya akan pergi sendiri. Untuk urusan Mokosh, saya akan mengirim perwira logistik saya untuk menghubungi Anda—apa pun itu, Anda bisa menyampaikannya langsung pada saya.

column1: I have to say, you seem to have no interest in Mokosh's regime. Mangi Security put in a lot of effort, I thought this should be your most important moment.
column2: Harus saya akui, Anda tampaknya tidak tertarik pada kekuasaan atas Mokosh. Mangi Security sudah berjuang keras, saya kira ini semestinya momen terpenting Anda.

column1: I am just an ordinary member working in a P.M.C., leave politics for the higher-ups to discuss.
column2: Saya cuma anggota biasa yang bekerja di sebuah P.M.C., biar urusan politik dibahas para atasan.

column1: Good mindset, I will report your achievements upwards.
column2: Pola pikir yang bagus, saya akan melaporkan pencapaian Anda ke atas.

column1: Is that so? If it's a commendation delivered to my door, I won't refuse. In return, when I obtain intelligence, I will share it with you.
column2: Begitu ya? Kalau penghargaannya diantar sampai ke depan pintu, saya tidak akan menolak. Sebagai gantinya, kalau saya mendapat informasi, saya akan membaginya dengan Anda.
